rationale: Record two Pulp-owned Canvas2D shim correctness fixes: strokeRect now passes the current lineWidth to canvasStrokeRect (with an empty colour that keeps the active strokeStyle) instead of letting the native stroke_rect default to a 1 px hairline, and assigning a solid strokeStyle after a pattern clears the stroke shader the pattern installed, as it already did after a gradient. The change stays inside the existing web-compat Canvas2D shim and its tests, adds no Vellum implementation or authority transfer, and leaves the accepted expansion boundary unchanged.
